full_prompt_en: A square painterly digital portrait shows a blonde young woman turning her head toward the viewer against a dark, softly glowing olive-brown background. Her face fills the upper center and right side of the image, while thick, loose waves of pale gold hair flow across the left edge and around her shoulders. The body is cropped close below the shoulders, with only a dark muted garment visible at the lower left. Her head turns slightly over her shoulder, making the near cheek and jaw catch warm light while the far side of her face falls into gentler shadow. Brown eyes look directly outward beneath strong dark brows and finely defined lashes; the expression is still and watchful. Small freckles and irregular warm flecks are visible across her forehead and cheeks, and her lips have a soft pink-brown color with restrained highlights. Individual strands and broader painted ribbons mingle in the hair, where bright cream-gold edges separate curls from the dim setting. At the right edge, a few circular amber points blur into the distance; they add atmosphere without forming a distinct object. The background remains low in detail and softly graduated, keeping attention on the face. Smooth transitions shape the skin, but faint painted texture and selective crisp marks around the eyes prevent a fully photographic finish. Warm light arrives from behind and the upper right, outlining flyaway strands and shoulders, while a subdued frontal fill keeps the features legible. The overall composition uses a close crop, glowing hair, and deep warm shadows to create an intimate, cinematic fantasy illustration.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形绘画式数字肖像呈现一位金发年轻女子在深色、柔和发光的橄榄褐背景前回头望向观者。她的脸占据画面上方中央及右侧，蓬松的浅金色波浪长发沿左边缘并绕过肩部。身体在肩下不远处裁切，左下只露出一小部分暗而柔和的衣服。她的头从肩后略微转回，靠近观者的脸颊和下颌接住暖光，脸部较远一侧则落入柔和阴影。棕色眼睛从浓深眉毛和细致睫毛下直视画外，神情安静而警觉。额头和面颊上可见细小雀斑与不规则暖色斑点，嘴唇呈柔和粉褐色，只有克制的亮部。头发中既有单根发丝，也有较宽的绘画式发束，明亮的奶油金色边缘把卷发从昏暗环境中分开。右边缘几个琥珀色圆点虚化在远处，增添气氛而未形成明确物件。背景保持低细节并柔和渐变，使注意力集中在脸上。平滑过渡塑造皮肤，但微弱的绘画肌理与眼周选择性清晰的笔痕使它并非完全摄影式完成面。暖光从后方及右上方射来，勾亮飘散发丝与肩部，同时柔弱的正面补光让五官仍可辨认。整体构图以紧凑裁切、发光的头发和深暖阴影，营造亲密而有电影感的幻想插画。
style_prompt_en: The image has a painterly digital finish built from smooth tonal modeling and selective, fine-edged detail. Warm cream, honey, and muted rose lift out of an olive-brown field, with the brightest rim accents reserved for loose curved edges. Broad shaded planes stay soft, while a few small high-contrast marks create a precise focal area. Fine strands and broader flowing strokes overlap, so polished surfaces retain a visible painted rhythm. The surrounding dark field falls away gradually, punctuated by sparse blurred amber glows. Backlight creates luminous outlines, and weak frontal fill preserves form inside the shadow. Close cropping and an uneven balance of bright and dark areas give the composition an intimate, cinematic intensity.
style_prompt_zh: 画面以平滑的明暗塑造和选择性的细边缘细节形成绘画式数字完成面。暖奶油色、蜂蜜色与柔玫瑰色从橄榄褐底色中浮出，最亮的轮廓光留给松散弯曲的边缘。宽阔的阴影面保持柔和，少量高反差细笔痕构成精确焦点。细丝状线条与较宽的流动笔触重叠，使光洁表面仍保有可见的绘画节奏。周围深色区域逐渐退去，零散的模糊琥珀光点点缀其间。逆光生成发亮的轮廓，微弱正面补光则保留暗部形体。紧凑裁切和不均等的明暗面积，让构图带有亲密的电影式张力。
theme_en: A warmly backlit close portrait of a blonde young woman turning toward the viewer
theme_zh: 一位金发年轻女子在暖色逆光中回望的近景肖像
name: Charlie Bowater
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
